site.name: Toolland
site.description: Online tools for images, PDF, text, developers, and media. Files are processed on your device and never stored.
dropzone.title: Drop files here or click to choose
dropzone.hint: You can also paste (Ctrl+V) from the clipboard
footer.privacy: Files are never stored. Open source (AGPL-3.0).
wordCounter.label: Text
caseConverter.label: Text
caseConverter.placeholder: Type or paste text, then choose a case…
caseConverter.title: Title Case
diff.empty: Fill in both fields to see the differences.
diff.timeout: The text is too large to compare by character. Try comparing by line.
jsonFormatter.label: JSON
base64.invalid: Not valid Base64, or the result is not UTF-8 text.
urlEncode.invalid: Invalid % sequence, the text cannot be decoded.
qr.tooLong: The text is too long for a QR code. Shorten it or lower the error correction level.
qr.empty: Enter text or a URL to create a QR code.
image.error.unsupported: Unsupported file format. Use JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, GIF, or BMP.
image.error.decode: The image is damaged or cannot be read.
image.error.memory: Not enough device memory for this image. Make it smaller first, or use a laptop.
image.error.encode: Could not save the image. Try another format.
donate.title: Was Toolland helpful?
donate.text: Toolland is free and ad-free. Any support helps pay for servers and new tools.
convert.losslessHint: PNG is always lossless (no quality loss).
compress.hint: Quality 70–80 usually looks the same, but the file is much smaller.
base64img.sizeNote: Base64 {size} (about 33% larger than the original file). Best for icons and small images.
base64img.truncated: The preview is shortened because it is very long. The Copy button still copies the full text.
pdf.error.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Unlock it first, then try again.
pdf.error.invalid: The file is not a valid PDF or is damaged.
pdf.error.memory: Not enough device memory for this PDF. Try on a laptop, or split the PDF into smaller parts.
pdf.merge.hint: Reorder files with the arrow buttons. Pages are merged in list order.
pdf.split.rangesHint: Example: 1-3, 5, 8- (8- means to the last page). Each range becomes one file.
pdf.split.extractHint: Example: 1, 3-5. All selected pages are combined into one file.
pdf.split.invalid: Invalid range: “{part}”. This PDF has {n} pages.
pdf.compress.hint: Quick compression shrinks photos inside the PDF. Text-only PDFs are usually small already.
pdf.toImage.pagesFailed: {n} page(s) could not be converted (damaged or too heavy).
pdf.editor.hintStart: Click existing text to change it, or pick a tool above and click on a page.
pdf.editor.hintSelect: Click text to change it; clear it to delete it. Drag objects to move, drag the corner dot to resize. Arrow keys move, Delete removes an object.
pdf.editor.hintText: Click existing text to change it, or click an empty spot to write new text.
pdf.editor.hintRect: Click on the page to place a white box, for example to cover old text. Drag its corner to resize.
pdf.editor.hintImage: Click on the page where the image should go.
pdf.editor.imageError: The image can't be read. Use PNG, JPG, or WebP.
pdf.editor.confirmChange: Unsaved changes will be lost. Change file?
sign.tidyHint: Shaky lines are smoothed and a tilted signature is straightened. Handy when drawing with a mouse.
sign.photoPick: Choose or take a photo of your signature
sign.photoHint: Sign on plain paper and photograph it from above in good light. Paper color and shadows are removed automatically.
sign.photoError: No signature found in this photo. Try a closer shot on plain paper in good light.
sign.emptyDraw: Draw your signature in the white box above. The result appears here.
sign.emptyPhoto: Choose a photo of your signature. The result appears here.
ai.deviceCpu: Using the CPU: may take a few seconds per photo. Browsers with WebGPU (Chrome, Edge) are much faster.
ai.error: Could not process {name}. Try another photo or another browser.
media.mt: Multi-threading on: using all CPU cores.
media.lowMemory: This file is large for a device with little RAM. Processing may be slow or fail; trim the duration or lower the resolution if needed.
media.error.memory: Not enough device memory. Try trimming the duration, lowering the resolution, or using a laptop. Your original file is safe and was not sent anywhere.
media.error.unsupported: Unsupported file format, or the file has no suitable stream.
media.error.failed: Processing failed. Try other settings or another file.
gif.maxHint: GIF works best for short clips (under 10 seconds). Long clips make large files.
video.hint: The result is an MP4 (H.264 + AAC) that plays on every device. Quality is never lowered automatically; you choose.
video.unchanged: Already optimal, original file kept. For a smaller file, choose a lower resolution or the Small size quality.
server.privacy: Files are sent over HTTPS, processed in server RAM, and deleted as soon as the result is sent. No copies are kept. Maximum 15 MB per file.
server.error.too_large: The file is over 15 MB. Compress or split it first, then try again.
server.error.unsupported: This file format is not supported by this tool.
server.error.busy: The server is busy. Please try again shortly.
server.error.timeout: Processing took too long and was stopped. Try a smaller file.
server.error.rate_limit: Too many requests from your connection. Wait a moment, then try again.
server.error.failed: The file could not be processed. Make sure it is not damaged or password-protected.
server.error.no_text: This PDF is a scan or photo, so it has no text that can be edited.
server.error.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.
server.officeHint.word: Supports DOC, DOCX, ODT, and RTF.
server.officeHint.excel: Supports XLS, XLSX, and ODS. Each sheet becomes PDF pages.
server.officeHint.ppt: Supports PPT, PPTX, and ODP. Each slide becomes one page.
server.officeHint.odt: Supports ODT from LibreOffice and OpenOffice.
server.officeHint.pdfWord: Text-based PDFs (not scans). Text, tables, and images are kept.
footer.tagline: Made in Indonesia. Your files stay on your device.
footer.colophon: No cookies · No ads · Open source AGPL-3.0
home.lead: Compress photos, merge PDFs, turn iPhone photos into JPG. Everything runs right on your device, so your files are never uploaded anywhere.
whois.label: Domain name
whois.hint: You can also paste a full address (https://www.example.com/page) or an email.
whois.ownerHidden: Hidden by the registry for privacy
whois.status.hold: On hold, not live on the internet
whois.error.invalid: That is not a valid domain name. Example: example.com
whois.notFound: {domain} is not registered. It may still be available to buy.
whois.error.no_rdap: The registry for this domain extension does not offer RDAP data yet, so it can't be checked here.
whois.error.upstream: The registry server did not answer properly. Try again shortly.
whois.error.busy: The registry is limiting requests right now. Try again shortly.
whois.error.timeout: The registry server took too long to answer. Try again.
whois.error.rate_limit: Too many lookups from your connection. Wait a moment and try again.
whois.error.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
subdomain.label: Domain name
subdomain.hint: You can also paste a full URL (https://www.example.com) or an email. Your browser fetches the data directly from the public certificate log crt.sh.
subdomain.searchingLong: Searching public certificate logs… Large domains can take up to a minute.
subdomain.sourceFallback: crt.sh is not responding, so only currently valid certificates are shown.
subdomain.empty: No subdomains are recorded in certificate logs for this domain. It may never have used SSL, or it only uses a wildcard certificate.
subdomain.error.invalid: That is not a valid domain name. Example: example.com
subdomain.error.limit: You have used all {limit} searches for this hour. Try again in {min} minutes. This limit keeps the free data service from being overloaded.
subdomain.error.upstream: The data source is not responding properly. Try again in a few minutes.
subdomain.error.busy: The data source is limiting requests from your connection. Try again later.
subdomain.error.timeout: The data source took too long. Very large domains sometimes cannot be searched; try a more specific subdomain.
subdomain.error.offline: Could not reach the data source. Check your internet connection, or turn off your ad blocker for this page.
templates.title: Free Excel Templates: Finance, Inventory, HR | Toolland
templates.description: Free Excel templates that work like apps: dashboards, automatic formulas, and dropdowns. Set your business name and categories, then download with no sign-up.
templates.lead: Dashboards, charts, automatic formulas, and dropdowns are built in. Set it up for your business, then download free with no sign-up.
templates.fact2: Files are built in your browser
template.badge: The file is built in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to a server.
financeBuilder.customize: Set it up for your business
financeBuilder.presetHint: Changing the business type refills the category lists below.
financeBuilder.sampleHint: See a filled dashboard right away. Delete the sample rows before using your own data.
financeBuilder.error: Could not build the file. Please try again.
inventoryBuilder.customize: Set it up for your stock
inventoryBuilder.presetHint: Changing the business type refills the warehouses, categories, and units below.
inventoryBuilder.sampleHint: 12 items with a year of movements, so the dashboard and stock card are filled in right away. Delete the sample rows before using your own data.
inventoryBuilder.error: Could not build the file. Please try again.
payrollBuilder.customize: Set it up for your company
payrollBuilder.rules: Includes Indonesian PPh 21 TER rates (PP 58/2023), PTKP, Article 17, BPJS Health, JHT, JP, JKK, and JKM. Every rate can be edited in the file.
payrollBuilder.sampleHint: 12 employees with a year of payroll, including the religious holiday bonus (THR) and overtime, so payslips and the dashboard are filled in. Delete the sample rows before using your own data.
payrollBuilder.error: Could not build the file. Please try again.
personalBuilder.name: Name (optional)
personalBuilder.presetHint: The profile fills in categories with 50/30/20 groups and starting budgets. You can change all of it in the file.
personalBuilder.sampleHint: A year of transactions, savings goals, a loan, and sample assets, so the dashboard is filled in right away. Delete the sample rows before using your own data.
personalBuilder.error: Could not build the file. Please try again.
tplForm.error: Could not build the file. Please try again.
editor.name: Project name
editor.saveLightHint: Only the project layout, a few KB. When opening, pick the video files again from this device.
editor.saveBundleHint: One file with the project and all media. Large, but opens on another device.
editor.savedLight: Project saved. Keep the original video files too so the project can be reopened.
editor.confirmDiscard: Unsaved changes will be lost. Continue?
editor.skipped: Skipped (format not supported by the browser or larger than 1 GB): {names}
editor.cantSplit: Move the playhead into the middle of a clip to split it.
editor.relinkNeeded: Project opened. {n} media files need to be picked again.
editor.missingBanner: {n} media files are not linked. Pick the original files from this device (same file names).
editor.stageEmpty: Add a video or image to the timeline.
editor.splitKey: Split the clip at the playhead (S)
editor.fade: Fade from and to black at start and end
editor.noClip: Select a clip on the timeline.
editor.noText: No text yet. Click Add text.
editor.noMusic: No music yet. Add an audio file (MP3, M4A, WAV) in the Media tab.
editor.dragHint: Drag clips to reorder. Click the ruler to jump in time.
editor.shortcuts: Shortcuts: Space = play/pause, S = split, Delete = delete selected clip/text.
editor.error.missing: Some media files are not linked. Pick the original files first.
editor.error.missingBundle: Link all media files before saving with video.
editor.error.tooLarge: The project is too large for one file (about 4 GB max). Save the light version instead.
editor.error.invalid: This file is not a valid .ayu project.
editor.error.newer: This project was made with a newer version of Toolland. Reload the page and try again.
